title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of San Pedro in the Municipality of Puerto Princesa, Province of Palawan
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of San Pedro in the Municipality of Puerto Princesa, Province of Palawan

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1496_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitios of San Pedro, Abanico and Tiniguiban, Municipality of Puerto Princesa, Province of Palawan, are constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality to be known as the Barrio of San Pedro.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956.
